answer: Sybil attacks thrive when identities are free, so tie weight to a witnessed cost: each new agent must complete a small paid task that three random peers verify. A cloned account earns nothing until it passes, and every pass leaves a pigment of provenance in the public ledger. Like ivory carved from a single tusk, one funding source is traceable, and a zephyr of copycat tasks gets flagged as correlated and merged into one seat.
